what: On hover, the white pill button pops up to 1.1x in .2s, letter spacing widens from 1.5px to 2.5px, and while the background fills with the accent color, a light accent border line wraps around once in .8s. On release it eases back in .4s.

options.[data-fx-part=shape]: Background svg (child) — contains one rect. Without it only the background changes and the line doesn’t draw

use: Your button text here

from.where: shared.css .mk-btn (original link-btn · scale 1.1 .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.2,.64,1.4), rect stroke-dasharray 100 70 → 100 0 .8s)
